modules.label: Assessments

modules.backend_status: local synthetic 15 detectors, frozen three-dimension scores and risk jobs; pre-transfer decisions not implemented

modules.label: Alerts
modules.label_th: กล่องงานแจ้งเตือนความเสี่ยง

Alert review is unverified opinion, not mature training label

modules.label: Network Explorer
modules.label_th: เครือข่ายบัญชีและเส้นทางเงิน
modules.backend_status: bounded synthetic temporal graph/path prototype only; verified account identity and graph scale pending
modules.ui_status: proposed; browser acceptance not established by plan
limitations: No verified account graph from masked text/HMAC/transfer.id
Partial/unresolved identity remains explicit; gate account graph/velocity when identity insufficient
No assumption internal-bank or out-of-network transfers are visible
No unbounded graph query; scope must be enforced by backend

modules.label: Cases
modules.label_th: งานสอบสวนและมอบหมาย
modules.backend_status: No.37.1 backend local MVP; No.38.1 synthetic API case demo; case UI/attachments pending
modules.ui_status: proposed; browser acceptance not established by plan
fields: Up to 20 linked alerts in local MVP
limitations: Detail route proposed /cases/:id
Actual scope names not supplied in plan; role labels above are proposed UX personas
Case create/link,assign,work,reopen,evidence/audit permissions explicitly separated in plan
Version CAS + idempotency; stale updates show conflict and preserve draft
Changed assignment/evidence/reopen requires outcome re-evaluation; keep prior history
Attachments and production SOP/directory/retention are pending; show disabled capability with explanation
Case closed does not mean legitimate; case actions do not automatically acknowledge/review alert

modules.label: Outcomes & Label Review
modules.label_th: ผลสอบสวนและการทบทวนป้ายกำกับ
modules.backend_status: local per-dimension analyst opinions exist; adjudication/maturity/sampling/training export not implemented
modules.ui_status: proposed; browser acceptance not established by plan
limitations: Do not map local suspicious/legitimate opinions to confirmed_suspicious/confirmed_legitimate automatically
All current case outcomes analyst_reviewed/unverified, training_eligible=false
Unknown/not reviewed/no alert/case closed never auto-negative
No training export button enabled merely because case is closed

modules.label: Detector Catalog
modules.label_th: กฎและตัวตรวจจับความเสี่ยง
modules.backend_status: 15 bilingual synthetic detector definitions and basic immutable amount-rule versions reported
modules.ui_status: proposed; browser acceptance not established by plan
limitations: Plan states total15 detectors but does not enumerate all detector IDs; do not invent authoritative detector names
Restricted typed DSL only; no JavaScript/Python/arbitrary SQL editor
Backtest has no live alerts, push or money effects
Rule approval/production effective-date lifecycle is distinct from implemented local policy lifecycle

modules.label: Risk Policies
modules.label_th: เวอร์ชันนโยบายและการอนุมัติ
modules.backend_status: No.36.1 local immutable policy lifecycle, comparison, generation CAS activation/rollback; production governance pending
modules.ui_status: proposed; browser acceptance not established by plan
actions: Activate/rollback local namespace binding with expected generation
limitations: Creator/submitter cannot approve own policy
Activation is local policy selection binding; does not activate live payment enforcement
Comparison advisory, not mandatory approval attestation in local MVP
Already accepted jobs keep frozen approved policy/hash/receipt after activation changes
Do not imply effective-dated production rollout exists

modules.label: Evaluation & Models
modules.label_th: การประเมินและวงจรโมเดล
modules.backend_status: target design; FastAPI diagnostics only; no trained production model/evaluation acceptance
modules.ui_status: proposed; browser acceptance not established by plan
limitations: Unavailable metrics shown as N/A + reason; no invented accuracy95%
Synthetic labels test plumbing only
Rules/anomaly/graph can be developed without supervised labels
No claim SQL/Python graph or MLflow is deployed merely because recommended
External vendor/GNN/GPU conditional, no top-level vendor shopping menu

modules.label: Datasets & Imports
modules.label_th: ข้อมูลนำเข้าและการตรวจสอบความครบถ้วน
modules.backend_status: No.35.1 profiler,35.2 staging import/reconcile,35.3 threshold simulation replay local CLI reported
modules.ui_status: proposed; browser acceptance not established by plan
actions: Future approved upload/import controls after API contract
limitations: Current interface is CLI, not proven browser upload/import API
Current local per-file limit64MiB and100000 records; approximately2GB export not supported as a single file
User chose manual export→Flash drive→offline import/reconcile before sync; actual source/export path not supplied
Staging raw rows are not canonical transactions; API/app/reviewer/outbox cannot read raw staging
Offline raw-amount threshold replay is simulation; it creates no operational alert/account/graph

modules.label: Data & System Health
modules.label_th: สถานะข้อมูลและบริการ
modules.backend_status: local operations/diagnostics/sync states and backup restore reported; real CDC/stream/model and production SLO pending
modules.ui_status: proposed; browser acceptance not established by plan
limitations: No connection secrets/config editor or production start/stop controls invented
Null replica lag is unknown, not zero
Readiness green does not prove real source/models/production readiness
Kafka/Flink/Valkey/PostgreSQL are status drilldowns; not separate main nav modules
5M/day remains capacity target pending measured end-to-end gate

modules.backend_status: fake transactional outbox local foundation only; actual Web App delivery/subscription/push acceptance pending
modules.ui_status: proposed; browser acceptance not established by plan

No real send/test-push button enabled by default

No account/name/amount/raw evidence on lock screen
Web App/Add to Home Screen selected; offline/service worker/push not thereby implemented
Alert remains in inbox when notification denied/offline/expired

modules.label: Audit
